definitions.full: H5184. Nachath III. נַ֫חַת proper name, masculine 1. son of Reuel, grandson of Esau Gen 36:13 , 17 (P; ᵐ5 Ναχομ , Ναχοθ ᵐ5 L Ναχεθ ), 1Chr 1:37 ( ᵐ5 Ναχες , A ᵐ5 L Ναχεθ ). 2 grandson of Elkanah 1Chr 6:11 , ᵐ5 Καιναθ , ᵐ5 L Νααθ ; — probably corrupt for תּוֺחַ v. 6:19 , or תֹּחוּ 1Sam 1:1 (see these words and We de Gent. 37 f. [who proposes תַּחַת for נַחַת ], Dr 1:1 ). 3 an overseer, Hezekian's time 2Chr 31:13 , ᵐ5 Μαεθ , A Ναεθ , ᵐ5 L Νααθ .
